title: NavigationPositionSelectors
description: Opt-in read-only position projection on solar-system-get. The ship must be owned by the authenticated player and have valid durable, backend-controlled persisted purchase lineage. Runtime-only placement proofs are test-only, not a production issuance path. Legacy/starter ships without valid backend-issued lineage remain unsupported. Target epoch comes exclusively from the verified unchanged ship position epoch. No client basis assertion, client propagation, seeding, or world repair. At most one planet/moon candidate. A geometric preview uses only supported navigationState positions at its epochMs, with distinct preview-only destination/candidate markers rather than ordinary stored Viewer meshes.
